detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Hatsune Miku returns for round 2 with more of your favourite tracks!

Featuring SIX new Rhythm Rifts:

  • "Highlight" by KIRA

  • "CONNECT:COMMUNE" by FLAVOR FOLEY

  • "Artifact" by buzzG

  • "Hello Builder" by Utsu-P

  • "Wonder Style" by colate

As a bonus to celebrate this release, enjoy a free Rhythm Rift:

  • "My One and Oni" by Danny Baranowsky

Each Hatsune Miku Rhythm Rift features:

  • Hatsune Miku in an exclusive new outfit designed specifically for Rift of the NecroDancer

  • Background visualizer with custom particle FX

  • Four Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible

  • Remix Mode: Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design

  • Buying any song from this Music Pack also unlocks custom Hatsune Miku items to equip in your Rift Profile!
